ABOUT RICHAURA

Understand the business.
Then build its growth.

A creative and performance marketing partner built around your business, your customers and your next opportunity.

THE THINKING BEHIND RICHAURA

Every business has value.
Marketing helps people see it.

Richaura began with a simple observation: every business has a story, a vision and something valuable to offer. The challenge is communicating that value to the right audience.

We bring creativity, technology, data and strategy together to help businesses establish their presence, connect with their ideal customers and work towards sustainable growth.

Our role is to be a strategic growth partner: understanding the business before recommending the marketing.

MEET OUR FOUNDER

Kirti Tiwari

Founder · Richaura

6+years of marketing industry
experience

Understand the business first.
Market it second.

Kirti’s work is shaped by the connection between creativity, consumer psychology and business strategy. With over six years in marketing, her experience spans brand strategy, digital marketing, performance advertising, creative communication, content strategy, product photography and customer acquisition.

Working across different businesses taught her that there is no one-size-fits-all strategy. Every brand has different customers, challenges and growth objectives.

She founded Richaura to bridge the gap between creative marketing and business performance, helping businesses move beyond isolated marketing activities towards a structured approach to growth.

OUR THREE PRINCIPLES

A connected approach.

Good marketing combines a clear plan, meaningful communication and the discipline to learn from results.

01

Strategy

Understand your business, audience, competitors and growth opportunities. Give every marketing decision a clear purpose.

02

Creativity

Communicate your value through distinctive visuals, meaningful content and a consistent brand voice.

03

Performance

Use data, analytics and advertising to reach relevant people, understand outcomes and improve the next campaign.
